fee_notes: Fee varies by restaurant type and purchase sequence. Traditional restaurants: $18,000 for first unit, $10,000 for second and each subsequent unit. Non-traditional restaurants: $10,000 for first unit, $6,900 for second and each subsequent unit. Simultaneous multi-unit purchases have additional reduced tiers (as low as $4,400 for third+ non-traditional units purchased at the same time). Eligible Military, honorably discharged veterans, wounded warriors, active duty spouses, and 501(c)(3) organizations receive a 20% discount (e.g., $18,000 reduced to $14,400 for first traditional). No refunds under any circumstances. No fee due on transfer or renewal. Optional signature product license fees estimated at $2,500–$5,000 (under development).
raw_excerpt: You will pay a $18,000 lump sum Initial Franchise Fee for your first traditional restaurant. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced to $10,000 per restaurant for your second and each subsequent traditional restaurant. ... You will pay a $10,000 lump sum Initial Franchise Fee for your first non-traditional restaurant. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced to $6,900 per restaurant for your second and each subsequent non-traditional restaurant.
